# Ski Guide — llms.txt

> A human & AI-agent-friendly ski reference covering exercises, equipment, and destinations.
> All data is programmatically accessible via an MCP server endpoint.

## Site

- Home: /
- Exercise module: /exercise
- Equipment module: /equipment
- Places module: /places

## AI / Agent access

### MCP Server (preferred for agents)

- Endpoint: POST /api/mcp
- Protocol: JSON-RPC 2.0, MCP spec 2024-11-05
- Discovery: GET /api/mcp returns tool list

#### Available tools

- **ski_list_exercises** — list exercises; filter by `difficulty` (beginner|intermediate|advanced|expert) or `type` (technique|fitness|balance|conditioning)
- **ski_get_exercise** — get full exercise details by `id`
- **ski_list_equipment** — list equipment; filter by `category` (skis|boots|poles|helmet|clothing|safety|accessories) or `skillLevel`
- **ski_get_equipment** — get full equipment details by `id`
- **ski_list_places** — list ski resorts; filter by `country` or `difficulty`
- **ski_get_place** — get full resort details by `id`

#### Example: initialize

```json
POST /api/mcp
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05","clientInfo":{"name":"my-agent","version":"1.0"}}}
```

#### Example: list tools

```json
POST /api/mcp
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list"}
```

#### Example: call a tool

```json
POST /api/mcp
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"ski_list_places","arguments":{"country":"France"}}}
```

## Content summary

### Exercises (6 entries)

Covers: parallel turn (intermediate/technique), carving (advanced/technique), wall sit (beginner/conditioning), single-leg balance (beginner/balance), short radius turns (advanced/technique), lateral hops (intermediate/fitness).

### Equipment (8 entries)

Covers: all-mountain skis, alpine ski boots, ski poles, ski helmet, avalanche airbag pack, avalanche transceiver/beacon, ski goggles, merino wool base layer.

### Places (6 entries)

Covers: Les Trois Vallées (France), Zermatt (Switzerland), Verbier (Switzerland), St. Anton am Arlberg (Austria), Niseko United (Japan), Les Deux Alpes (France).

## Structured data notes

Each page renders `data-*` attributes on article elements for machine parsing:
- Exercise articles: `data-exercise-id`
- Equipment articles: `data-equipment-id`
- Place articles: `data-place-id`
